summary: Build practical workplace investigation and disciplinary action skills with evidence-led exercises, templates, and reporting practice. Enrol today.
lede: Compliance investigation training helps HR and employee relations professionals investigate workplace concerns and support evidence-based disciplinary decisions. Participants practise scoping allegations, preserving and reviewing records, planning and conducting interviews, and assessing credibility and alternative explanations. They also develop findings reports, decision records, and proportionate corrective-action plans to document consistent case handling.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate workplace concerns, advise on disciplinary action, or make employment decisions based on evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of employee relations, HR case handling, workplace conduct policies, or disciplinary processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You should bring familiarity with your organization’s investigation policy or case workflow where permitted, while protecting confidential information.
